quarterly_data.quarter: Linktel Technologies half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Product line includes 800G OSFP / QSFP-DD modules (SR8, 2xFR4, 2xFR4 silicon photonics and silicon-photonics LPO, DR4, 2DR4, 2DR4 TFLN), 1.6T OSFP modules (2DR4, 2FR4, LRO and LPO variants) and ELSFP-VHP / UHP light sources for optical engines in switches, NICs and AI; the company has joined an international standards body drafting NPO / CPO specifications and is building the related process and test platforms.

quarterly_data.quarter: Linktel Technologies half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Dual production bases in Wuhan, China and Penang, Malaysia, with Malaysia already a considerable share of output (Malaysian subsidiary revenue RMB 439,351,131.76, net loss RMB 53,746,284.67); products are sold mainly to the US and Europe; customers include some well-known global cloud service providers and AI computing solution providers; optical and electrical chips for high-speed modules come mainly from overseas vendors.
